sections.title: 5.3.3 Microscopic Findings
sections.text: Microscopic examination was performed on all animals. Splenic extramedullary haematopoiesis, grade 2, was present in Group 3 (40 mg/kg/day) in 5 of 10 animals and Group 4 (120 mg/kg/day) in 6 of 10 animals. No other treatment-related findings were identified.

sections.title: 5.3.4 Conclusion
sections.text: No adverse treatment-related findings were identified at any dose level tested. The no-observed-adverse-effect level (NOAEL) for Compound HX-074 is **120 mg/kg/day**, the highest dose tested. No lowest-observed-adverse-effect level (LOAEL) was established. The splenic extramedullary haematopoiesis is considered non-adverse.
